literal_meaning: পেটে পড়া বা পোরা (falling or being put into the stomach)
figurative_meaning_en: To eat or devour in a contemptuous or greedy manner
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার শত্রুর সম্পত্তি পেটে পোড়ে নিয়েছে।
এই লোভী লোকটি সবকিছু পেটে পোরে।
example_sentences_in_english: He swallowed his enemy's property in contempt.
This greedy man devours everything ravenously.
note: This idiom reflects Bengali cultural attitudes towards gluttony and disdain in consumption.
